question: Can independent exposure anchoring plus source-only variance-weighted multi-exposure fusion close the unchanged P3U quantization/noise gates?

fusion.latent: one source exposure base per pattern and scalar
fusion.source_correction: divide each observed source by one plus its independent measured gain nuisance
fusion.normalized_observation: gain-corrected source divided by nominal exposure scale
fusion.variance_model: source_noise_sigma squared plus uniform quantization variance, propagated through gain correction and exposure normalization
fusion.reconstruction: fused latent base times each nominal exposure scale

unchanged_evaluation.observations: exact P3U 16/12/10-bit source and target observations
unchanged_evaluation.truth_cases: exact P3T six pure plus two mixed cases
unchanged_evaluation.mechanism_candidates: exact P3T physical and lens families
unchanged_evaluation.automatic_gates: exact P3U per-regime and common gates

forbidden: change fusion weights, anchor levels, observations or gates after scoring
read any target or outcome while fusing sources
fit spatial denoisers or learned models
drop dark pixels, rows, patterns or the 10-bit regime
claim real acquisition calibration, film measurement or product readiness

branch_rule.pass: Retain anchored bracket fusion as a synthetic acquisition-sufficiency result and compile a minimal controlled chart protocol.
branch_rule.fail: Close the exact fusion estimator without weighting or threshold rescue; require a different observation design.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic acquisition-sufficiency evidence for anchored multi-exposure source fusion; no real-film, stock, device or product calibration claim.
